move: prompt types, Generate fills, tiles shimmer, four images resolve from blur
how: A white app card rises in with four grey tiles staggering in (scale .9, power3.out). A caret blinks and from 9% TextPlugin types the prompt over 1.8s; at 34% the Generate button presses (scale .93 yoyo), its label swaps to Generating and a purple fill grows scaleX 0 to 1 over 2.2s (power1.inOut) while a white shimmer sweeps xPercent -100 to 100 across each tile twice with a 0.12s stagger. From 55% the tile artwork resolves: opacity 0 to 1, filter blur(24px) to 0 and scale 1.1 to 1 with a 0.18s stagger (power2.out), number tags pop, and the colour blobs inside drift for 3s. At 65% the label reads Done and the fill turns green. From 87% the images blur back out, the prompt clears and the button resets with set() calls at the last frame.
adapt: Replace the app name, model tag, prompt string and the four gradient/blob compositions (or use real images in .art); keep the 2.2s fill and the 0.18s blur-resolve stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the app, appends grain overlays and the SVG noise filter inside el; animate returns the timeline with typing at 0.09D, generate at 0.34D, resolve at 0.55D and reset at 0.87D. Uses filter: blur on four tiles and an feTurbulence grain filter, both port directly; register TextPlugin and scope selectors to el.
caveats: animates filter: blur(24px) on four tiles plus a feTurbulence grain overlay with mix-blend-mode, the heaviest frames are the resolve
caret tween uses repeat:-1, an infinite child; size it to D when porting
